session.title: Sepang coaching day (3-hour travel, low-stress support only)
session.purpose: Protect adaptation from Tuesday by making Thu a recovery-priority non-ride day despite a full schedule.

dose.movement: Optional 10-20 min walk or light mobility only.
dose.cap: No planned endurance MTB/intervals and no gym loading.

session.adaptation_hypothesis: Reducing training friction on Thu protects Friday-endurance quality and lowers the chance of avoidable fatigue accumulation.
execution_rules: Keep body stress low while coaching for focus and hydration.
No long screens/late night push before sleep.
No hard riding unless required to move; if any spontaneous ride happens, keep it <20 min Z2.

expected_result.next_day: higher confidence and fresh baseline entering Bukit Dinding practice.

stop_rules: If stress rises and recovery drops, do zero exercise.
If sharp pain/early fatigue signals appear during travel, skip any optional movement.
